curated.instructions: omr/instructions/42060-1-1.pdf (book 1 builds the truck, its trailer and the mini excavator, steps 1-106; page 83 shows every function); omr/instructions/42060-1-2.pdf builds the alternate model

functions.does: The black gear on the cab roof steers the truck's front wheels: its shaft runs down through the cab to a 12 tooth gear, which turns a 20 tooth gear on an upright shaft whose crank arm pushes the track rod between the two steering knuckles.
functions.source: book: page 83 (the finished model with the roof knob); the steering is inferred from the model's parts (the roof gear, the 20 tooth gear with the crank arm p74 and the track rod p73)

functions.does: Turning the axle end on the side of the truck under the tipper tips the tipper up: a crank arm on the axle pushes the tipper's front up, and turning it back lowers it.
functions.source: book: page 83 (the arrow at the axle end and the raised tipper)

functions.does: The truck's four wheels roll freely.
The trailer hangs on a hitch behind the truck and swings from side to side as it is towed; its two small wheels roll.
functions.source: book: page 82 (the truck towing the trailer)
functions.note: p216 is on the hitch; p224 and p225 are the trailer's wheels

functions.does: The round knob on top of the excavator's engine cover raises and lowers the boom: its upright shaft carries a worm, which turns a 20 tooth gear, whose crank arm pushes the boom up or lets it down.
functions.source: book: page 83 (the top left pictures: the knob, with the boom lowering)

functions.does: Turning the axle at the boom's elbow swings the excavator's arm and bucket in and out: a crank arm on the axle pushes the arm about its pivot on the boom.
functions.source: book: page 83 (the top right pictures: the axle end with its arrow, and the arm swinging)
functions.note: which parts make the arm is read from the model: the bucket hangs on the 7 long beam p295

functions.does: The excavator rides on two tracks of chain links, each over two 16 tooth gears, and rolls along on them.
The excavator's bucket sits on a hinge arm at the end of the arm and can be set at an angle by hand.
functions.source: book: step 95 (the bucket on its hinge arm)
functions.note: a click hinge, set by hand; unsure whether it's meant as a function
